ValidationRule.description: Moving to Funded needs an approved amount, a funding date, and every approval and closing condition cleared.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Stage__c), ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Booked"), OR( ISBLANK(Approved_Amount__c), ISBLANK(Funding_Date__c), Open_Approval_Conditions__c + Open_Closing_Conditions__c > 0 ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Before moving to Funded, enter the Approved Amount and Funding Date, and satisfy or waive every prior-to-approval and prior-to-closing condition.
